::: {.callout-warning}
**Deprecated. Do not use these tables in new work.** Use [IBM Verify
Counts](ibm_verify_events_transformed.qmd), built from the IBM Verify event
stream. These tables will stop updating when the reporting API pull is
decommissioned.
:::

## Data retention

The API keeps only 90 days of per-user data, so the year-to-date and 365-day
unique-user figures it computes can undercount. Daily rows stored on our side are
unaffected.
